piece: An asset library that reads every file
title: Every file in the Drive,
found by what it shows.
sub: How the marketing Drive became a library you can ask in words, in the order it was built.

now.v: Two days to map the whole Drive, estimated

rows.v: 78%, now found by what they show
Each clip's first 10 s, then 97 h read whole
The second inside a clip, not the file

title: Every search
began in a folder.
chapters.sub: The files were all there, but the folders did not say what was in them.
thought: Walked the Drive read-only and counted first
Asked whether a path names its campaign: 78% no
Kept the folders, planned a search over them

call.said: Drive's folders stay where they are; the library searches over them.

frame.head: How a file was found before
frame.datum: 82,615 items · 3.1 TB · 78% tied to no campaign
frame.caption: Six hands-on steps for every file

title: The whole Drive,
read by a vision model.
chapters.sub: Every unique video and real image was looked at, and anything that could not be read was listed with its reason.
thought: Drive is slow per request, not per byte
Fetched starts and ends, decoded keyframes only
Read clip openings first, then every clip whole
Could not read a file? Wrote down why

call.said: Go ahead: read every clip whole.

frame.head: What was read
frame.caption: One overnight read, then every clip whole

rows.v: 2 to 10 s, where it had taken minutes

title: Sorted by
what each file shows.
chapters.sub: Each read became a point, and points that read alike sit together, in 60 groups.
thought: Embedded each description, label and folder
Found 60 groups, named each from its samples
Laid them out so near means alike

frame.head: The Drive as mapped
frame.caption: The map, one grain for every 34 items

title: Briefs and designs
on the same map.
chapters.sub: Every readable Monday board and the Figma files it links were laid out beside the Drive.
thought: One model, one space for all three sources
They grouped by kind of text, not by subject
So kept each item's nearest in every source
And the 598 links the briefs already make

call.said: Publish the public boards and creative requests; the rest stays out.

frame.head: Three sources, one layout
frame.datum: One embedding space for all three
frame.caption: Drive, Monday and Figma, laid out together

stations.title: Only what is published
stations.note: References to unpublished items cut to zero

title: Ask in words,
land on the moment.
chapters.sub: A question is read, searched three ways, and the top frames are checked before anything counts as a match.
thought: Read the question: parts, colours, what's absent
Searched words, meaning and pictures; fused by rank
Checked the frame at the second it returned
Nothing holds? Said that nothing was found

frame.head: One question, end to end
frame.datum: 0.45 to 0.7 s over 105,395 items · 7 to 9 s with the frame check
frame.caption: Three searches, one checked frame

stations.title: Product on a sink, nobody in the shot
Ranked together, filters inside each list
The frame at the returned second, top 20
